texts.zh:
我们建立沟通的尝试代表了我们技术上的成熟，但结果并不理想。如果宇宙中还有其他智能生物的话，也许是些只具备动物水平智能的家伙吧。

前智慧生物跟可没法搞什么外交，但取决于你的帝国类型，有时候可以对他们提升、灭绝、奴役或者进行观察。
texts.en:
Our attempts to establish communications stand testament to our technological ingenuity, but results are lacking. It is likely that the other party possesses only an animal level of intelligence, if any at all.

Pre-Sapients offer little to no diplomatic interactions, but depending on your empire type, they can sometimes be uplifted, exterminated, enslaved, or observed.
